name: TOTP Sign-In Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers real-path TOTP proof for accepted and rejected sign-in plus the mobile token adapter through AuthenticationFlowService, the typed TOTP handler, the real AppUserMfaManager and the real LagoVista SignInManager on the browser-session path.
notes: AppUserMfaManager is never mocked. Both browser and mobile proofs execute its real TOTP verification and replay-protection logic.

The browser-session proof also uses the real LagoVista SignInManager; persistence, secure storage, redirect resolution and the ASP.NET Identity SignInManager adapter are infrastructure/framework seams.

The mobile adapter proof mocks IAuthTokenManager only after the real TOTP proof has succeeded. It verifies that the proven durable identity is converted to the established single-use-token grant contract; token issuance itself is an existing independently-owned authentication subsystem rather than the TOTP credential operation under proof.

The successful browser-session path currently also emits PasswordAuthenticationSucceeded from shared CompleteSignInToAppAsync. That legacy event is recorded explicitly rather than hidden by the proof.
